issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 01 requests exactly the zoo names and internet addresses (url) and the name and Regierungsbezirk of the respective Gemeinde, but the solution uses a SELECT Zoo.*, Gemeinde.* which returns all columns from both tables (including columns not requested). This conflicts with the explicit instruction to output exactly the requested columns and not more, and may confuse students about the expected result columns and automatic grading.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution to select only the requested columns, e.g. SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk FROM Zoo JOIN Gemeinde ON Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel. This preserves the intended join while ensuring only the exact required fields are returned.
